recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，大部分細胞的細胞質充滿粗大、折光的橘紅色顆粒，核為雙葉或圓形（嗜酸性骨髓細胞），嗜酸性球系列明顯增加。
features: Numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes with coarse refractile orange-red granules
Bilobed nuclei in mature forms; round to indented nuclei in precursors
Some cells with admixed darker granules suggesting immature eosinophils
Scattered erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and occasional neutrophils
No compact mast cell aggregates or blast sheets in this field
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow section (H&E) shows a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors with coarse, refractile orange-red cytoplasmic granules; mature forms have bilobed nuclei and precursors have round to indented nuclei. Erythroid precursors and neutrophils are present in smaller numbers, and no blast sheets or compact mast cell aggregates are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; the differential between reactive eosinophilia and a clonal eosinophilic neoplasm requires clinical and genetic correlation.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; FIP1L1::PDGFRA detection, elevated tryptase and loose CD25+ mast cells support the clonal diagnosis.
Mastocytosis shows dense spindled mast cell aggregates with CD117/tryptase/CD25 and KIT D816V.
Neutrophil precursors have fine pale pink-lilac granules, not coarse bright orange-red granules.
LCH shows eosinophils among sheets of CD1a/langerin-positive cells with grooved coffee-bean nuclei.
